capabilities: scan notes for #billable entries by client and date range
generate numbered Markdown invoice notes with line items and totals
mark invoices paid, unpaid, or voided and track outstanding balances
manage client details such as rates, currency, and address
export invoices to PDF or print (Pro)
extras: Freemium: the capture-to-invoice-to-paid workflow is free; Pro ($15 one-time, offline Ed25519 license verification) unlocks PDF export, tax and per-client currency, and due-date reminders. PDF export is desktop-only. Listed as Optional payments in the community directory.
problem: Freelancers who already log work in their notes must re-enter that time in a separate invoicing app to bill clients.

requires.name: Invoice Forge Pro ($15 one-time via Buy Me a Coffee)

summary: Time-billing tool that scans notes for #billable lines, builds numbered client invoices, and tracks payment status; Pro adds PDF export, tax, and reminders.
